resources.string: This phone can\'t run Tofu itself: the local kernel needs a 64-bit ARM (arm64-v8a) device.
This build of the app doesn\'t include the local kernel.
Tofu can start on this phone only while the app is on screen. Open it and try again.
Tofu stopped on this phone before it was ready.
Tofu on this phone did not pass its health check (%1$s).
Otherwise it stops when you leave it with no task running and no schedule enabled.
Notifications are off: Tofu still runs on this phone, but its status and Stop won\'t appear in the notification shade. Stop it here instead.
This phone\'s kernel runs under proot, which this app includes together with talloc.
proot: GPL-2.0-or-later, conveyed under GPL-3.0-or-later because libproot.so links talloc statically. Copyright STMicroelectronics and the PRoot and Termux contributors.
talloc, with its lib/replace objects: LGPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright Andrew Tridgell, Stefan Metzmacher, Jelmer Vernooij, Volker Lendecke and the other Samba contributors.
The GNU General Public License version 3, which LGPL-3.0 section 4(b) requires next to it.

Source offer. The complete corresponding source of libproot.so and libproot-loader.so is the proot and talloc source archives pinned by SHA-256 in android/native/pins.env, together with android/native/ (build-proot.sh, pins.env, talloc-cross-answers.txt and patches/) of the Tofu %1$s source this app was built from. They are published with each release of the app that contains these files.
